stories.name: Project Foundation & Build System
stories.description: Set up CMake build system, project structure, arm-toolchain, and emulator framework with Qt/SDL2.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Build System
  Scenario: Firmware compiles with ARM toolchain
    Given the firmware source is in place
    When I run cmake with ARM toolchain
    Then the ELF binary is generated
  Scenario: Emulator runs on desktop
    Given the emulator source is in place
    When I build the emulator
    Then the Qt emulator window opens

stories.name: MIDI Input & Instrument Selection
stories.description: Implement MIDI note-on/note-off handling, instrument selection via MIDI CC, and basic routing to synthesizer.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: MIDI Input
  Scenario: MIDI note-on triggers synthesizer
    Given a MIDI keyboard is connected
    When I press Middle C
    Then the synth generates a tone at 262 Hz
  Scenario: MIDI CC selects instrument
    Given the synth is running
    When I send CC#0 value 0 (Piano)
    Then the instrument switches to Piano

stories.name: Audio I/O & Simple Oscillator
stories.description: Initialize audio subsystem, implement basic sine/square/sawtooth oscillators, output to speakers.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Audio Output
  Scenario: Sine wave oscillator produces 440 Hz
    Given the audio engine is initialized
    When I trigger note A4 (440 Hz)
    Then audio output measures ~440 Hz ±1 Hz

stories.name: Piano Engine (SoundFont-based)
stories.description: Integrate SoundFont2 loader, implement polyphonic piano voice allocation, velocity sensitivity, and reverb.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Piano Instrument
  Scenario: Grand piano plays polyphonically
    Given a Grand Piano preset is loaded
    When I play a 4-note chord
    Then all 4 notes sound simultaneously with realistic decay

stories.name: Electric Piano (Rhodes & Wurlitzer)
stories.description: Implement Rhodes tine physical model and Wurlitzer FM synthesis, chorus/phaser effects.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Electric Piano
  Scenario: Rhodes plays with velocity-dependent tone
    Given Rhodes preset is loaded
    When I play soft and hard notes
    Then soft notes are warmer, hard notes are brighter

stories.name: Organ Engine (Bethree Integration)
stories.description: Integrate GPL-licensed Bethree Hammond organ engine, implement 9-drawbar configuration, Leslie effect.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Organ
  Scenario: Drawbars control harmonic content
    Given organ is loaded
    When I adjust 16' drawbar to full
    Then bass frequencies increase proportionally

stories.name: Melotron Tape Playback
stories.description: Implement tape playback engine for MK400 Violins, Choir, Flute; support stacking all three; tape saturation emulation.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Melotron
  Scenario: Tape rewinds when note is released
    Given Melotron Violin is selected
    When I hold and release a note
    Then tape sound fades and rewinds

stories.name: Polyphonic Synth Pads (Arp & Strings)
stories.description: Implement wavetable synth with envelope, arpeggiator, string pad with chorus/reverb.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Synth Pads
  Scenario: Arpeggiator plays notes in sequence
    Given Arp Synth is loaded
    When I hold a 3-note chord
    Then notes play in up/down pattern at tempo

stories.name: Effects Chain (Reverb, Chorus, Phaser)
stories.description: Implement Freeverb reverb, LFO-based chorus, and phaser; route each instrument through effect chain.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Effects
  Scenario: Reverb tail decays over time
    Given reverb is enabled at 100% wet
    When I play and stop a note
    Then reverb tail audibly decays for 2+ seconds

stories.name: Hardware Control Mapping
stories.description: Map 16 knobs and 8 faders to instrument parameters (drawbars, effects, envelopes); EEPROM persistent config.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Hardware Controls
  Scenario: Knob 1 controls organ reverb
    Given organ is selected
    When I turn knob 1 clockwise
    Then reverb amount increases

stories.name: Preset Management System
stories.description: Implement JSON preset loader/saver, factory presets for all instruments, SD card storage.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Presets
  Scenario: Load preset from SD card
    Given a preset file exists on SD card
    When I select it from the UI
    Then all instrument parameters are restored

stories.name: Touchscreen UI Implementation
stories.description: Design and implement instrument select, preset browser, parameter editor, reverb/effects visualizer.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: User Interface
  Scenario: Tap instrument button to select
    Given the UI is displayed
    When I tap the Piano button
    Then Piano is selected and UI updates

stories.name: Audio clicks on note-on
stories.description: Eliminate audio artifacts when notes trigger.
stories.cucumber_test:
Feature: Audio Quality
  Scenario: No click on note-on
    Given a synthesizer is playing
    When a note triggers
    Then no audible click occurs
